item.description:
Release v5.6.5

Changes since v5.6.4

  • docs: update cross-plugin comments referencing ConversationManagerPlugin
  • feat(LLMProviderMiniMaxPlugin): unified status bar token plan display
  • feat(MenuBarHelperPlugin): scaffold new plugin for menu bar settings UI
  • feat(MenuBarManagerPlugin): enable menu bar icon by default
  • feat(MessageRenderer): lazy-load tool results from ToolManager on demand
  • feat(MiniMax): parse thinking tags and flush tool calls in streaming
  • feat(ToolManager): add in-memory result cache for immediate UI resolution
  • feat(ToolManagerPlugin): persist and lookup tool results by tool call ID
  • feat(ToolManaging): add toolCallResult lookup by tool call ID
  • fix(AgentTurnRunner): track completed tool calls via separate .tool messages
  • fix(LLMProviderMLXPlugin): inject pluginSubdirectory via storage bridge on boot
  • fix(LLMProviderMLXPlugin): register MLX local provider settings view
  • i18n: translate or localize content
  • perf(LLMProviderManagerPlugin): defer provider loading after first frame
  • refactor: rename ConversationStorePlugin SPM module to ConversationManagerPlugin
  • refactor(ConversationManagerPlugin): rename main plugin class and update internal identifiers
  • refactor(ConversationManagerPlugin): update user-facing display name and translations
  • refactor(LLMProviderMiniMaxPlugin): drop labels from status bar token plan display
  • refactor(MenuBarManagerPlugin): extract ViewContainer to MenuBarHelperPlugin
